# CampusCrack

> CampusCrack is an AI-powered exam-prep platform for Nigerian university students. Students upload course materials and CampusCrack generates CBT and written practice exams, AI-graded written tests, flashcards, and personalised study plans.

CampusCrack was founded by Greatness Ajibola Alawode, Founder and CEO, a Cybersecurity student at Bowen University, Iwo, Osun State, Nigeria, building CampusCrack as a solo founder. Full access costs ₦3,500 per semester; the free plan includes 3 question-set generations.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://campuscrack.com.ng): what CampusCrack does and how it works
- [About](https://campuscrack.com.ng/about): the founder and the story behind CampusCrack
- [Pricing](https://campuscrack.com.ng/pricing): free plan and full-access plan details
- [Sign up](https://campuscrack.com.ng/signup): create a free account
